decisions.evidence: The main limitation is safety: it hallucinates drug interactions more often than large models.
PocketClinic runs fully on a hospital tablet, so patient data leaves neither the device nor the care setting.
PocketClinic focuses on offline execution and explicitly leaves external grounding for future work.
The adapter rank is selected to fit a hospital tablet GPU.
PocketClinic begins with a 3B Small Language Model.

decisions.limitation: Performance gap remains with full fine-tuning
decisions.evidence: PocketClinic reaches 51.0% MedQA accuracy, approximately 80% of CuraLM-70B's 63.8%.
